acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Harpies family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Skyrender, T3, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Crosswind-Lane Specialist (Specialist) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two normal construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Vivid iridescent feathers, raised crest, spear-length claws, and differently colored bands on the two wing tips create a fully realized asymmetric specialist silhouette.

Signature mechanic: Rend the Sky: the Skyrender paints one lane with the bright left wing band, climbs, then crosses it with the right wing and spear-length talons; only their intersection is trapped, while the wedge behind the dim wing remains safe.
battlefieldDuty: Qualitatively pivot the encounter by cutting one aerial lane into two crossing threat windows with independently banded wing tips.
constructionDimensions: Family-native, non-affinity wing anatomy, ordinary wing beats, loose-feather wind halo, molting feathers, hollow bone, sinew, raw hide, and cliff dust remain physical family traits rather than Wind affinity construction.

Motion remains ordinary flight: feathers shed from strain, talons scrape stone, jewelry swings under gravity, and the source wind halo consists only of displaced loose feathers with no supernatural pressure wake.
counterplay: Match the first band to its lane, move into the dim-wing wedge, and strike the overextended second wing root after the crossing pass. Affinity signal: The wing-root dip, folded leading edge, exposed ankle ring, or planted talon preserves each form's established physical weak point.
forbiddenTreatments: Treating ordinary wings, flight, or the Sky Queen's loose-feather wind halo as Wind affinity
identityInvariants: A humanoid torso remains joined to large raptor wings that replace or extend the arms, backward-jointed bird legs, oversized talons, and a feathered head crest.
Slate gray, brown, and dirty cream mature into iridescent blue-green, storm purple, and white without losing the family feather pattern.
Feather, hollow bone, sinew, raw hide, braided hair, and gold ankle ornaments remain physically readable materials.
Bone jewelry, trophy feathers, braided hair, ankle rings, and crest height communicate status without changing the core wing-and-talon silhouette.
Every attack keeps the wing roots, talons, crest, and flight direction visible enough to preserve counterplay.
telegraph: Its raised crest turns toward the crossing point while one iridescent wing-tip band flashes, followed by the opposite band at a different angle.
